devdoc.details: Unaudited. Testnet use only. There is no owner, pause or rescue function.

SafeERC20FailedOperation(address).details: An operation with an ERC-20 token failed.

createAgreement(address,address,uint64,s.details: Requires an ERC-20 allowance covering the total. Reverts on any invalid input.

params.amounts: One amount per milestone, in token units
params.deadlines: One submission deadline per milestone (unix seconds)
params.freelancer: Address that will do the work
params.reviewPeriod: Seconds the client has to approve or dispute a submission
params.title: Human-readable agreement title

params.reason: Why the work is disputed (emitted only, not stored)

resolveDispute(uint256,uint256,uint256).details: Only possible while block.timestamp <= disputedAt + ARBITER_TIMEOUT. After that,      resolveDisputeAfterTimeout takes over, so the two paths never overlap.

params.freelancerAmount: Amount paid to the freelancer; the rest goes to the client

resolveDisputeAfterTimeout(uint256,uint2.details: Requires block.timestamp > disputedAt + ARBITER_TIMEOUT. An odd leftover unit goes to the client.

params.note: Link or note about the work (emitted only, not stored)

devdoc.title: MilestoneEscrow

ARBITER_TIMEOUT().notice: How long the arbiter has to resolve a dispute before anyone can trigger a 50/50 split.

acceptAgreement(uint256).notice: Freelancer accepts the terms. The agreement becomes Active.

approveMilestone(uint256,uint256).notice: Client approves a submitted milestone and pays the freelancer.

cancelAgreement(uint256).notice: Client cancels before acceptance and gets the full total back.

claimAfterTimeout(uint256,uint256).notice: Freelancer claims payment once the review period has passed without a response.

createAgreement(address,address,uint64,s.notice: Create and fund an agreement. The caller becomes the client.

declineAgreement(uint256).notice: Freelancer declines before accepting. The client is refunded in full.

disputeMilestone(uint256,uint256,string).notice: Client disputes a submitted milestone while the review period is running.

getMilestones(uint256).notice: Read all milestones of an agreement.

refundMilestone(uint256,uint256).notice: Client reclaims a milestone the freelancer never submitted by its deadline.

resolveDispute(uint256,uint256,uint256).notice: Arbiter splits a disputed milestone between the two sides.

resolveDisputeAfterTimeout(uint256,uint2.notice: If the arbiter stays silent, anyone can split the disputed milestone 50/50.

submitMilestone(uint256,uint256,string).notice: Freelancer submits a milestone. Allowed after the deadline if not yet refunded.

userdoc.notice: Holds a client's payment and releases it to a freelancer one milestone at a time.
